decisions.conflict: Final stack, cloud and libraries/providers unselected
decisions.options: Spring Modulith vs NestJS; one chart/broker; cloud evaluation
decisions.evidenceRequired: Architecture feasibility, team capacity, official support and selection ADR

decisions.conflict: Lock/controller compatibility, offline/re-entry/revocation and clocks untested
decisions.options: Test exact models/local schedules/manual fallback; do not promise cloud unlock offline
decisions.evidenceRequired: Physical model/firmware/API/outage/egress evidence

decisions.conflict: 18+ draft applies all guests; digital verification covers booker
decisions.options: Defined on-site originals process vs approved alternative; manual exceptions
decisions.evidenceRequired: Qualified policy review, operational process and identity/OCR validation

decisions.conflict: Staff-less visuals versus physical cleaning/emergency intervention
decisions.options: Accountable onsite/on-call staffing, cleaning checklist and emergency plan
decisions.evidenceRequired: Venue staffing/responder drills and physical readiness clearance

decisions.conflict: Privacy, storage provider, regional processing and retention undecided
decisions.options: Private storage/provider review; minimal data; defined retain/delete/backup handling
decisions.evidenceRequired: Privacy/legal review, data-flow map and deletion/access tests

decisions.conflict: Payment providers/merchant product/country support unverified
decisions.impact: Ability to collect/refund/reconcile lawfully under provider terms
decisions.options: PayHere or supported bank IPG; Stripe only if eligible
decisions.evidenceRequired: Official docs and merchant confirmation; sandbox/webhook/refund evidence

decisions.conflict: Refund fees/taxes/cancellation and card re-billing not finalized
decisions.impact: Purchased terms, financial disputes and compensation
decisions.options: Versioned explicit policy; no automatic new charge without approved consent/capability
decisions.evidenceRequired: Finance/product/provider/legal approval and lifecycle tests

decisions.conflict: Loyalty earning, reversal, expiry/redemption and promotion stacking undefined
decisions.options: Defer feature or approve versioned eligibility/rates/caps
decisions.evidenceRequired: Product/finance rules and abuse/reversal tests

decisions.conflict: Temporary hold range 10–15 min is not precise
decisions.impact: Expiry UI, payment handoff and inventory utilization
decisions.options: Choose configurable 10 or 15 minutes (or justified value) later
decisions.evidenceRequired: Checkout/provider timing and conflict/expiry tests

decisions.conflict: Cleaning buffer after closing not resolved
decisions.options: Disallow buffer beyond closing vs permit staffed post-close cleaning
decisions.evidenceRequired: Operating/readiness approval and boundary tests

decisions.conflict: Requested source palette differs from checked-in proposed tokens
decisions.options: Preserve active tokens now; explicit future palette migration after contrast review
decisions.evidenceRequired: Design owner reconciles source pack; rendered/token contrast evidence

decisions.conflict: Multi-venue scope is not an approved multi-tenant/subscription SaaS model
decisions.options: Venue-scoped single organization vs explicit future tenant isolation
decisions.evidenceRequired: Architecture/business scope decision and isolation tests

decisions.conflict: Physical occupancy detection and overstay evidence unvalidated
decisions.impact: Unsafe empty-room assumptions and false dashboards
decisions.options: Keep booking-based status; label physical unknown; evaluate validated sensors/staff checks
decisions.evidenceRequired: Hardware/privacy accuracy and safety review

decisions.conflict: Commercial screening/streaming/gaming/media rights unverified
decisions.options: Obtain appropriate rights or restrict advertised/offered amenities
decisions.evidenceRequired: Qualified commercial/licensing/venue review; no legal claim from PDFs

decisions.conflict: PDF sources/knowledge pack absent; no page-level verification
decisions.options: Supply actual sources; read text and relevant image-only/Sinhala pages; reconcile via ADR
decisions.evidenceRequired: Accessible originals, checksums, page evidence and conflict review

decisions.conflict: Recognized revenue and sellable-minute policy not approved
decisions.options: Cash collections separate; recognized accrual only after approved policy; explicit blackout/buffer denominator
decisions.evidenceRequired: Finance definitions and backend aggregate fixture checks

decisions.conflict: Package proration, rounding, zero-price and tax treatment unresolved
decisions.impact: Exact payable totals and permitted shorter/included duration choices
decisions.options: Initial extension-only no proration; resolve permitted zero/tax and exact rounding policy explicitly
decisions.evidenceRequired: Product/finance/policy decision and exact quote fixtures

decisions.conflict: Package price-change thresholds, role allocation and two-person approval not approved
decisions.impact: Who may edit/publish/archive and control sensitive changes
decisions.options: Independent capabilities; self-publish vs approval workflow/threshold by scope
decisions.evidenceRequired: Accountable role/scope matrix and approval/audit acceptance

decisions.conflict: Scope precedence and sales/session-validity version selection needs final approval
decisions.impact: Deterministic applicable version and scheduling concurrency
decisions.options: Reject overlapping intersecting scope; decide explicit venue/room override if needed; distinguish sales vs service windows
decisions.evidenceRequired: Boundary/scope precedence and concurrent-publish evidence

decisions.conflict: Valid quote honor, deactivation/emergency withdrawal and payment-timing evidence
decisions.source: S8 vs older generic revalidation language
decisions.impact: Fair accepted prices and late capture/expired-hold recovery
decisions.options: Recommend honor valid quote; capture-in-time vs callback timing; explicit emergency/withdrawal and approved cutoff alternatives
decisions.evidenceRequired: Provider timestamp authenticity, product quote policy and reconciliation scenarios

decisions.conflict: Minimum-duration operational-policy authority and change process
decisions.impact: Two-hour packages cannot bypass venue/global policy or terms
decisions.options: Separate authorized minimum update, precedence/effective date and customer terms; reject invalid package-only change
decisions.evidenceRequired: Source/policy review, approval rights and minimum boundary acceptance

decisions.conflict: Shared fee/add-on definitions versus deliberate package overrides
decisions.impact: No duplicate definitions/double charging or inconsistent override precedence
decisions.options: Versioned shared refs by default; override only after explicit design decision
decisions.evidenceRequired: Pricing ownership/version resolution and included-extra fixtures
